entries.en:
Duzal Meyean has asked you to synthesize high-quality disposal unit components, that crews may safely relieve themselves aboard the Dezul Qualan. Proper equipment to craft these items, however, is only found at the Diamond Forge in Revenant's Toll. Speak with forgewife Fyrbryda about receiving permission to utilize the facilities.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level.

entries.en: Fyrbryda's rules for the forge are simple: one, all materials brought inside must be inspected for contraband, and two, if anyone wishes to make use of the facilities, they must first provide a generous contribution to the Revenant's Toll chapter of the Adventurers' Guild. Currently, the guild has need of morbol vines, which will be used to craft stronger ropes for the miners who scale the mountains of Mor Dhona. Travel to the Tangle and slay a resident morbol for its feelers.
entries.fr: Fyrbryda est prête à vous laisser utiliser les équipements de La Forge de diamant en échange d'un simple service. Partez à la chasse aux <frnoun(BNpcName,12,　237,2,1)> dans L'Enchevêtrement pour obtenir <frnoun(EventItem,1,2001418,1,1)>.
entries.ja: フィルブリダと話した。製作施設を使う条件として、「<sheet(EventItem,2001418,0)>」を調達しよう。「<sheet(EventItem,2001418,0)>」はタングル湿林にいる「<sheet(BNpcName,　237,0)>」を討伐することで、まれに得られるらしい。

entries.en:
Fyrbryda has granted you access to the Diamond Forge's crafting facilities. Use the materials given to you by Duzal Meyean and inspected by Fyrbryda to synthesize high-quality disposal unit components. Once completed, return to Ehcatl with the items.

※In the event that the status Facility Access: Specialization wears off or the synthesis ends in failure, you may try again by speaking with Fyrbryda.

entries.en: We're busy here at the Diamond Forge, so I won't waste time mincing words. My rules here are simple. Follow them, and you are free to use the facilities for as long as you need.

entries.en: Rule one─aught that passes through those doors must be inspected. I will have no contraband within my walls. Period. Rule two─you make a contribution of my choice to the Revenant's Toll chapter of the Adventurers' Guild. No questions asked. No exceptions.

だったら、ちょっと頼まれてほしいことがあるの。
「」を持ってきて。

entries.en: If that suits you, journey to the Tangle and collect a thick vine from a morbol. It will be used to make sturdy rope, that miners can more safely scale the rugged crags of Mor Dhona.
entries.fr: Tu as déjà remarqué ces cordes accrochées entre les bâtiments près de l'entrée du Glas<nbsp>? Comme certains aventuriers s'amusent à marcher en équilibre dessus, il faut ré<->gu<->liè<->re<->ment les remplacer pour éviter un accident.
entries.ja:
加工すると丈夫なロープになるのよ。
ふふっ……外の建物のあいだに綱が張ってあるでしょ？
あれで綱渡りする冒険者がいるから、強いのに替えたくて。

entries.ja:
ここレヴナンツトールの南西、「タングル湿林」にいる、
「」を討伐して手に入れてきて。
1体倒しただけじゃ無理かもしれないから、根気よくね。

entries.en: Journey to the Tangle and slay a morbol for one of its vines. Do that, and the facilities are yours to use as you see fit.
entries.fr: Avant d'utiliser nos ins<->tal<->la<->tions d'artisanat, tu dois m'apporter <frnoun(EventItem,1,2001418,1,1)>. Tu ne devrais pas avoir trop de mal à le trouver en terrassant quelques-uns de ces monstres vers L'Enchevêtrement, au sud-ouest du Glas.
entries.ja:
ふふっ……をお願いね。
対価として奉仕するのが、ここを使うための決まりごとよ。

entries.en: Quick now, before another miner meets an abrupt end.

entries.ja: おかえりなさい、成果はどうだった？

entries.en: Excellent! This will make for fine rope. As for your materials...though obviously of questionable origin, I have found naught the guild has deemed forbidden. Proceed, then.
entries.fr: Ouah, il est énorme<nbsp>! Je me demande toujours comment vous autres trouvez assez de place pour mettre tous ces trucs dans vos sacs... Bon, les matériaux sont en règle, donc tu peux t'en servir à ta guise. Merci<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ありがとう、助かっちゃったわ。
ふふっ……もちろん製作のための準備はできてるわよ。
材料はお返しするから、あとは存分に腕をふるってね。

entries.en: If you require more time or materials, do not hesitate to ask, for today I am in your debt. I did not mention this before, but my dearest childhood friend will soon take up mining, and the rope we will make shall serve him well. For the peace of mind you have given me, it is the least I can do.
entries.fr: Tu n'as plus assez de matériaux<nbsp>? À moins que tu veuilles travailler plus longtemps<nbsp>? Quoi qu'il en soit, si tu as quelque problème que ce soit, n'hésite pas à faire appel à moi<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
ふふっ……材料が足りなくなっちゃった？
それとも施設の使用時間を延長したい？
そんなときには、遠慮なく私に言ってね。

entries.en: I suppose this is farewell. If aught should happen to your work while on the road, do not hesitate to return here for additional materials, for this day I am in your debt. You see, I have just received word that my dear friend was in an accident...and were it not for his morbol vine rope, he would have fallen to his death like the others. Though he is injured, he will live to mine another day.
entries.fr: Tu as fini, on dirait. Heureu<if(gnum4,se,x)> du résultat<nbsp>? Dans ce cas n'attends pas pour livrer ton commanditaire, il n'en sera que plus satisfait<nbsp>!

ふふっ……仕事は終わったみたいだから、納品に行ったら？
万が一、製作した品をなくしたりして、
この施設をまた使いたいときには、遠慮なく私に言ってね。
